## ShopMate Industry ERP v4.3.1a

- Industrial Production & Manufacturing Manual: Integrated comprehensive visual guide and procurement procedures.
- Serial Number Lifecycle & Configuration: Advanced serial number settings, batch-level barcodes, and instant POS unbilled restock flow.
- Digital Signature Integration: Secure signature pad capture with automatic signatory stamping across invoices and vouchers.
- Smart Product Name Builder: Dynamic name generator for industrial components and trading items.
- Concurrency & Idempotency Hardening: Request deduplication keys across production batches, inventory movements, and transaction entries.
- Cash Flow Breakdown: Granular classification between Cash, Card, and MFS entries with autonomous ledger self-healing.
